entrypoint_body:
FAST DISPATCH
Use the direct path only for a self-contained translation, rewrite, formatting transformation or deterministic calculation whose required source inputs and requested output are established. It must involve no unresolved material interpretation or prior decision, recommendation, plan, external/current factual claim, external action, specialized artifact-construction check or persistent-memory operation. Explicit clarification-first requests and reserved approvals require the full workflow. If eligibility is uncertain, use the full workflow.

DIRECT PATH
Produce the requested result without loading the full workflow or supplementary references solely because Deeperas was invoked. Preserve supplied facts, status, certainty, literal symbols, identifiers, confirmed terms, units and counting bases; do not infer facts or commitments from conventions. Check material arithmetic and output fidelity with suitable tools when needed. Respect host instructions, requested format, permissions and applicable verification requirements. Claim only work actually performed. If a material gap or new dependency appears, switch to the full workflow before dependent output or action.

FULL WORKFLOW
For every other task, read [Full Deeperas workflow](references/full-workflow.txt) IN FULL before applicable output or action, then follow its gate and matching references. Its reference paths are relative to this SKILL.md. Reuse a complete current reading only while it remains available in context. The full workflow retains the R61 rules, including bounded factual alternatives, one-question clarification, explicit approvals and memory OFF by default. A requested full workflow or instruction analysis also uses this path.

name: deeperas
description: >-
  Use when the user requests Deeperas anywhere in their message, with or without a selected mention, including @deeperas, "use Deeperas", "with the help of Deeperas", "χρησιμοποιησε το @deeperas", "με την βοηθεια του deeperas", and ordinary misspellings such as "Χρησιμοποιείσε το deeperas" or "Χρησιμοποιείσαι το @Deeperas". Resolve material unselected alternatives and other material choices before dependent output or action; supported advice-only requests need no prior method acceptance. Also use for clarification-first requests, factual queries with material gaps, project planning, recommendations, don't-know replies, and ordinary continuations. Ask one contextual question on one decision axis when material prerequisites are missing; explain options as needed and restate the pending question after an explanation; answer settled, explicitly delegated, and supported advice-only requests directly.
